caption:
Ad spend gets blamed for revenue problems that live somewhere else.

Most service businesses only build one of the four systems that create revenue. Acquisition gets all the attention. Follow-up, CRM, and retention get ignored.

Run this audit this week:

01 Acquisition: pull your last 10 leads, count real fits
02 Follow-up: have a friend submit a test lead, clock the response
03 CRM: count open leads with no next action scheduled
04 Retention: check if a review or win-back ask fires automatically after every job

One broken link caps what every other system can produce.

rationale: 2026 benchmarks confirm carousels still win saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships the previously-unused unified four-systems framework (acquisition/follow-up/CRM/retention) as its own standalone audit, distinct from every specific stage, ladder, matrix, and cost model already shipped.
